(2) A seller or supplier by retail of any poison shall

(3) A seller or supplier of a poison referred to in
subsection 24(1) of the Act shall keep a Prescription Book
containing information and particulars required under that
subsection in accordance with Form C in the First Schedule

to these Regulations.".

Peraturan baharu 27A

4. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas peraturan 27

peraturan yang berikut:

"Preservation 27A. (1) A seller, supplier or licensed pharmacist shall
of document. ; ;

keep every register, record or book required to be kept under

the Act or these regulations on the premises of the seller,

supplier or licensed pharmacist for a period of five years from

the date the last entry is made to the register, record or book.

(2) A seller or supplier who receives a written order
or a prescription, either in writing or electronic form, in the
course of selling or supplying a poison shall keep the written
order or prescription on his premises for a period of

five years from the date of sale or supply of poison.

(3) Any person who contravenes this regulation
commits an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine
not exceeding five thousand ringgit or to imprisonment for

a term not exceeding two years or to both.".
